title: Where a Red Squirrel Stops to Watch and Eat
caption:
Where a Red Squirrel Stops to Watch and Eat — five-minute wild observations in just forty seconds. #WildVox #Animals #Nature #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: This red squirrel pauses among the branches, staying alert to the world around its perch.
narration_timeline.scene: Real red squirrel motion or alert posture among branches, no invented predator

narration_timeline.text: Another squirrel turns up on a city ledge, a reminder that trees are not its only stopping places.
narration_timeline.scene: Real red squirrel on a man-made ledge in Berlin

narration_timeline.text: Inside a park, two separately filmed squirrels move between branches and settle into the trees.
narration_timeline.scene: Two authentic Ljubljana park red squirrel branch recordings

narration_timeline.text: Near a stump, another squirrel investigates food, while a different one explores the logs nearby.
narration_timeline.scene: Genuine squirrel at walnut stump plus separate squirrel on logs and branches

narration_timeline.text: One squirrel uses a tree trunk as a pathway, holding on as it moves from place to place.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic red squirrel on tree trunk

narration_timeline.text: A final close view shows a squirrel handling food at a stump, ending this busy little journey.
narration_timeline.scene: Original red squirrel Nutkin footage visibly eating at tree stump
